title: Activity
description: One record: one bookable or doable activity or experience (tour, class, food tasting, outdoor adventure, show). Voyager use: activities (name, description, category, duration_hours, price_usd, location, rating, review_count, accessibility_features, family_friendly, age_suitability).

description.description: Two or three sentences: what you do.

city.description: City in English. Always paired with `country`.

country.description: Country in English (e.g. "Japan"). Required whenever `city` is set.

location.description: Neighbourhood or venue where it takes place.

text.description: The price exactly as written on the page, e.g. "€45.00", "from ¥1,500", "Free".

amount.description: The number in `text`, without currency symbols or thousands separators.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency in `text`; never converted.

unit.description: What the price is for, e.g. "per person", "per night", "per ride".

is_free.description: True only if the page says it is free (tips may still be expected).

price.description: Price per person unless `unit` says otherwise.

booking_url.description: Booking or detail link from the page.

phone.description: Operator phone. As written on the page (digits, spaces, +, -, (, ), .).

schedule.description: When it runs (days, start times, season) as written.

accessibility_features.description: Accessibility features the page states explicitly.

scale.description: Top of the rating scale (5, 10 or 100).

count.description: Number of reviews behind the rating.

rating.description: A rating shown on the page (never computed).

source_url.description: The page's own link for this item (official site, booking or detail page), copied verbatim from the page.

as_of.description: The "last updated", "valid from" or publication date the page itself states for this information (YYYY-MM-DD).

items.description: A verbatim quote from the page.

evidence.description: Up to 3 short verbatim quotes from the page that support the most important facts.
